rung_purposes.purpose: Detect conveyor motor overload trip (MOL-1001 not healthy)
Reset cell fault latch M190 via fault reset pushbutton PB-0002
Evaluate summary fault M199 from faults or tripped E-stop circuit
Energize conveyor motor contactor M-1001 in auto mode when fault-free
Indicate ST10 pallet in position from stop photo-eye PE-1001
Latch stopper release solenoid XY-1004 on line release request edge
Time stopper release duration (2.0 s via T11)
Reset stopper release solenoid XY-1004 when release timer expires
